lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno barked up at a tree,
The cat must be up there, you see!
Kiki giggled, look again,
The cat's in the other tree, my friend!
[chorus]
Barking up the wrong tree, barking up the wrong tree,
You've got the wrong idea, it's plain to see!
Barking up the wrong tree, barking up the wrong tree,
Look around and you'll find the key!
[verse]
It means your guess is not quite right,
You chase the wrong thing with all your might,
Stop and think and look around,
Then the answer can be found!
[chorus]
Barking up the wrong tree, barking up the wrong tree,
You've got the wrong idea, it's plain to see!
Barking up the wrong tree, barking up the wrong tree,
Check again and you'll be free!
[outro]
So if your idea's way off base,
Find the right tree, change your chase!
